study: Three-robot shared-exit discovery with and without communication

robot_a.role: informed; travels directly to the exit and announces only after physical discovery

communication.off: A knows the exit; B and C complete their frozen searches independently; no GoalAnnouncement and no peer CPA state is consumed
communication.on: A announces only after entering the exit; B and C immediately abandon their remaining search waypoints after the first valid announcement; multi-peer CPA selection is enabled

multi_peer_policy.risk_priority: smallest time-to-CPA, then smallest distance-at-CPA, then smallest robot id
multi_peer_policy.no_risk_fallback: nearest fresh usable peer, then smallest robot id
multi_peer_policy.stale_policy: fail closed by withholding selected-peer output whenever any configured peer is stale

formal_plan.primary_metric: paired makespan difference COMM_OFF minus COMM_ON
